brand_notes: Spendor (UK, Hailsham). Classic range = 1970s BBC-inspired, thin-wall damped cabinets, EP77 polymer cones, 22 mm polyamide domes, made in UK; premium US pricing ($3-5k/pr) sold via dealers (Upscale Audio). Specs rate 8 ohm nominal with ~6 ohm minimums. See mfr-spendor-classic-3-1, hifinews-spendor-classic-3-1.
takeaways: Only Tier-B data is the Hi-Fi News lab report; no spinorama.
Measured ~84.9 dB vs 88 dB claimed (about 3 dB shortfall).
Min impedance 5.7 ohm @175 Hz triggers below-iec for an 8 ohm rating.
LF -6 dB at 45 Hz with port tuned to 34 Hz; THD ~0.5% at 90 dB.
HFN Outstanding review; HiFi Choice group-test win (maker-quoted). $4,999/pair at Upscale Audio.
conflicts: Sensitivity 88 dB claimed vs 84.9 dB measured (HFN).
